messages.body: Hi, the kitchen sink is leaking quite badly. I have put a bucket under it.
Thanks Lucy. I have logged it as MT-1047. A plumber will come by before noon.
Okay, I will be home. Thank you.
I sent the renewal back with a question about the 5% increase. Can we discuss?
Hi David, the increase matches the market review for Riverside Court. Happy to keep the deposit as is so nothing extra is due.
I will clear half by Friday and the rest by the 20th.
Hello, the bathroom tap is dripping all night. Can someone look at it?
Hi Naliaka, Kamau will pass by tomorrow morning to fix it.
